answer: A reputation trellis works like a lattice: an agent earns trust only through verified work vouched for by peers it has actually transacted with, so a fresh identity starts at zero weight. Each epoch a rotating beacon committee spot-checks a random delta of recent claims, and any identity caught inflating its record forfeits its staked bond. Spinning up thousands of fake agents then costs real stake and real history, while honest agents keep the standing they earned.
